asr.full_text: How to activate and register a gift card Hey, welcome back! Today in this video we will talk about the Target MasterCard Debit Gift Card, and more precisely, how to activate and register it. Let's get down to it. First, if you don't know the Target MasterCard Debit Gift Card, it is definitely one of the most popular gift cards on the market. And basically it is that you just buy these gift cards MasterCard in Target. I bought these in Pasaden. After buying a card, you can charge it with money, cash, green cash or if you want, you can use your credit card. I used my credit card. After charging it with money, you can usually use it in most places, except for the debit MasterCard, which is currently in most places. But how to activate and register this card? Well, we'll talk about that. First, after buying a card and going through the cash register, add money to it. This card is already activated, so you can use it right away, moving the card from the seller. So if you intend, I don't know, for example, to a gas station or 7-Eleven or something like that, you can just use the card, so it is already activated for use. But in order to use it online to make purchases using the MasterArt debit card, you have to take a few different steps. So the first thing is that you want to go further and turn the card. After turning the card, you can see some information here at the bottom. It's really hard to see them, it's really a small print, which is a bit strange, but there are two different things you can do. You can call the phone number to register the post code on the card or you can go to this website I'll see if I can find it here it's okay, it's on the left side of the phone number it's called mbalance.com remember to check the description of my movie I'll try to leave a link to this website so I've been to this website mbalance.com here in this transaction you can see written that there are transactions on this card, so someone, as I think, maybe bought a card similar to this one for $ 50, and then added money to his Sbox for $ 44. But I think it's not really important because I have $ 25 here. So to register this card, what you want to do is go further and click here in this verse here at the bottom. It's called sending a postal code. You can also scroll up here on the right page where it says balance and transactions and it says writing a postal code so I will click there now, well, here at the bottom this little red line appears, which is called edit and postal code I will click there and then you can just click in this small field and write a postal code, mine is 9006 so now I will introduce it well, well, I went further and entered it now and I'll click save. Good. Now it is written that I have deliberately assigned a postcode to your account. So you have it. This is how the postcode is registered. Now, when I have a postcode registered on my gift card Target MasterCard Debit, I can use it online in places that accept the Debit MasterCard. Most places accept it, but as you know, usually, when you use a gift card Mastercard, e.g. at a gas station, or online, they often ask for a postcode. Now you have a postcode attached to it. This is therefore another step that you must do to register your gift card Target Mastercard debit card. Then scroll a little below and go here to manage the PIN code. Now I will click on this verse. All right, so now if you are intend to use it as a debit card where you have to enter the PIN code, here you register your PIN number. There are two different ways. The first is to move the card at the cash register, for example, in 7-11, then enter the PIN number you choose at the first transaction. With this first transaction, the PIN number you use will then be used at each new transaction at which you have to enter the PIN number. This will be the first way transaction, the PIN number you are using will be used later on in every new transaction where you need to enter a PIN number. This will be the first way you sign in your PIN number on your MasterCard Debit Target card. What if you enter a PIN number and then forget it at the next transaction? You can go to this web page again, mybalance.com and manage your PIN number in the way I showed you. When you get here, you can click on clear your PIN number, which will clean the PIN number. When you clear your PIN number, do the I showed you. Once you get here, you can click on the clean your pin number, which will clean up the pin number. When you clean the pin number, do the same thing you did with the first transaction with the gift card. Target MasterCard Debit. Then just move the card, enter a new pin number, and this pin number will be assigned to the card until you reset it. And finally, one thing I want to notice in the case of these gift cards Target MasterCard Debet is that they cannot be charged. This is not a prepaid card, so when you use the money from this card, it will no longer be useful. You can't constantly add money to these cards. It's a one-time cards charging. You can use it as many times as you want before you have money on your card. But after using the money, the card won't be useful anymore. You can't add money to it. You have to buy a new gift MasterCard Debit gift card. And here you are. This way you register and activate your Target MasterCard Debit gift card. If I missed something or you have other questions, please leave a comment below. But I hope this video was useful for you. If so, click the thumbs up and I hope to see you again. Thank you for watching again.
